license_note: Both the code repository and the model weights are released under the Modified MIT License, which reproduces the MIT grant but requires commercial products above 100 million monthly active users or 20 million US dollars in monthly revenue to prominently display 'Kimi K2.6'. That conditional attribution obligation is not part of the OSI-approved MIT text, so the release is source-available rather than open source.

license_evidence.scope: moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6 repository code and model weights, including derivative works
